dialog.title: Link “{{title}}” to TMDb
dialog.description: Pick the TMDb film or show this work is. Its ids are written into its items in Jellyfin: a film's, a series', or an episode's own IMDb id (by its season and episode) for an episode Jellyfin lists as a film. Jellyfin then fills in only what they are missing, as its Search for missing metadata does: their titles stay. An item says why when its link stays in the app.

catchUp.title: Update Jellyfin
catchUp.description: Links set before the app wrote series' and episodes' links into Jellyfin, and asked it to look up each item's missing metadata, are counted below. Update Jellyfin writes their ids now, one link at a time, and asks Jellyfin to look each item up, as its own Search for missing metadata does. A lookup Jellyfin didn't take isn't counted again: Retry in the work's TMDb dialog asks again.
